subject: POC keep-alive: clarify ownership & next milestones
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Lee <david@bluearclabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + proposed POC milestones

Thanks again for a productive demo earlier today, David — appreciate the clear use case detail. Per our conversation, I pulled together a short POC plan (attached) and a proposed success rubric so we can align expectations before we kick off. High-level items:  

- Success criteria (what BlueArc needs to see):  
  * 95% intent extraction accuracy on your labeled set (rolling aggregate)
  * End-to-end request latency <= 450ms p50 for 512-token average requests
  * Demonstrable reduction in manual triage time by 30% on sample ticket batch

- Data & access needed from BlueArc: sample dataset (redacted), API test key or staging endpoint, and a contact for SRE for network whitelisting.

- Proposed timeline: 2-week setup (data + access), 3-week evaluation (runs + metrics), final readout and decision week. I know you mentioned a tighter window — flagging that this is flexible if we compress the setup work.

Next steps I need from you to lock the timeline:  
1) Confirm the internal owner who will provide the sample data and sign off on success criteria
2) Grant a staging API key or URL (or confirm we should use file upload tests for the first week)
3) Any compliance constraints we should be aware of (data retention, PII rules)

Attached: POC-plan-v1.pdf (outline + runbook), sample-data-schema.csv (fields we expect), trial-test-cases.xlsx (initial test matrix).

If we can get points 1–2 by EOD Monday 5/10, we can start onboarding the week of 5/17. Otherwise I’ll propose the week of 5/24.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: David Lee <david@bluearclabs.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Anita Kumar <anita@bluearclabs.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + proposed POC milestones

Thanks Stephanie — solid recap and helpful attachments. Quick clarifications from our side:  

- Ownership: Anita (cc'd) will own data delivery and sign-off on the success rubric. I will be the sponsor.
- Timeline: We can compress setup to 1 week if Redwood can run an initial ingest using S3 drop and the API key by 5/17.
- Success criteria tweak: intent extraction threshold — we'd prefer you report both precision/recall since our labels have some ambiguity; target "balanced F1 >= 0.92" instead of percent accuracy.

We also have one compliance ask: sample data must be redacted to remove direct PII and stored only in staging for the duration of the POC. I'll send our standard DPA checklist by EOD.

Can you confirm whether we need an IP allowlist entry for your staging IPs or if a signed temporary token will work?

Thanks,
David
Director of Product Operations | BlueArc Labs
david@bluearclabs.com

Appreciate the quick turn, David — happy to adapt the rubric to F1 >= 0.92 (we'll report precision/recall breakdowns in the weeklies).  

On the integration side: we can accept an S3 drop for week 1 to accelerate setup. For network/access, we typically support both IP allowlist + short-lived tokens; for a first pass the signed temporary token is easiest, but if you prefer allowlisting we can provide the IPs. Ben, can you confirm the token TTL we usually provision for trials?

Ben: assignable tasks below — can you pick up the ingest scripts and the first-pass validation? Marissa: I'll need you to own the weekly metrics dashboard and the final readout slide deck.

If Anita can upload a small redacted sample to the Drive link I shared, Ben will kick off the ingestion and we can run a smoke test by Thu 5/13. Otherwise we pivot to the week-of-5/17 start.

Thanks all,
Stephanie
